description.value: Once per day, reroll a failed Perception check made to find hidden salvage or a hidden danger.

cinderfall.incomplete: The once-per-day reroll of a failed Perception check has no engine hook: no 'Reroll' rule-element key exists anywhere in pf2e (confirmed absence across the whole compendium) -- rerolls are implemented as GM/player-invoked table actions (Hero Point reroll), never as a rule element a feat can grant conditionally.
